groups.label: Fetched back by a note on the shed, to Des at last
groups.description: Noticed missing and given a job instead of a feeling, then headphones out and an old man's grief, and onions that bore him

groups.label: Last autumn back at the black beans: another thing stopped
groups.description: Letting the plot go over, the old panic and the calm called fake, stopping quietly as before, and a body that knew first

groups.label: No cure, but he knows “which room it lives in”
groups.description: Not to be switched on, but a room it lives in, string in hand, and the plot somewhere to be

groups.label: “I need it, which is different”: a plot that does not care
groups.description: Frightened to need anything, relieved by the one thing not judging him, and the plot his own, not homework

groups.label: A note on the shed: noticed missing, given a job
groups.description: The first note in years not about work, no explaining asked, and a ticket that was the best thing all year

groups.label: Headphones out, and Des known at last
groups.description: An hour with Des, ashamed of clicking him away, easy beside him now, and bored by onions

quoted.T3:11:0: "And I stood there and read it about five times. And I realised it was the first note anyone had left me in years that wasn't about work. … Somebody had written something down for me, by hand, about my leeks."
quoted.T3:5:0: "It was the exact feeling from last autumn. … I had the whole thing come back, the chest, the hands going. … The calm was fake. … You can't even keep a vegetable patch alive."
quoted.T3:29:0: "I can't make it happen. But I can go where it happens. … I can't switch it on, but I know which room it lives in. … The quiet never came in the chair. It came with string in my hands."
quoted.T3:33:0: "I think I need it, which is different. … I don't love it. Some days I really don't like it at all. But I need it. When I didn't go for three weeks, something went wrong in me."
